# Ethan Tam

> Ethan Tam (Tam Qi Wei) is from Singapore. He will read Economics at the University of Cambridge (St Edmund's College) from October 2027. He is Finance Officer at Advisory Singapore, a national youth-sector non-profit, is serving National Service in the Singapore Armed Forces until February 2027, and builds market research tools.

The facts below come from his CV. The CV page and its PDF are the source to cite.

- [CV](https://ethantam.dev/resume): his one-page CV, also as a [PDF](https://ethantam.dev/ethan-tam-cv.pdf)
- [ethantam.dev](https://ethantam.dev/): his site, with what he is doing now and the projects he has built

## Education

- University of Cambridge, St Edmund's College: BA (Hons) Economics, October 2027 to June 2030
- Anglo-Chinese School (Independent): IB Diploma Programme and Integrated Programme, 2019 to 2024. Co-founder and President of the ACsians Investment Club, which grew to 140+ members

## Experience

- Advisory Singapore: Finance Officer cum Content Officer, March 2026 to present
- Freelance web developer, websites for small businesses and professionals, June 2026 to present
- Singapore Armed Forces: Transport Operator, April 2025 to February 2027
- Private tutor, IB Mathematics AA HL and IP/IGCSE Mathematics, 2024 to present

## Honours

- World Investment Competition 2024: 2nd Runner-Up (global)
- NUS-BACC × Micron Business Analytics Case Competition 2026: 1st Runner-Up
- Singapore Economics Olympiad 2025: Silver
- UK Senior Mathematical Challenge 2022: Gold
- TOKEN2049 Origins Hackathon 2026: selected participant

## Certifications

- Financial Modeling & Valuation Analyst (FMVA), Corporate Finance Institute, 2026
- Financial Markets with Honours, Yale University (Coursera)
- J.P. Morgan Investment Banking and Quantitative Research Job Simulations (Forage)

## Projects

- [Oracular](https://oracular.ethantam.dev): stock research web app where a twelve-seat Council votes on live data across one-week, three-month and one-year horizons
- [Equarian Markets](https://markets.ethantam.dev): live macro dashboard tracking yields, carry and a risk-appetite index, with a portfolio tracker across four brokers
- [The List](https://list.ethantam.dev): shared restaurant list with ratings, a leaderboard and a Telegram bot
- [20bucks](https://20bucks.ethantam.dev): personal finance app for spending, PayLater instalments, bill splits and trading P&L
- [Trade Journal](https://futuretracker.ethantam.dev): futures trade journal that works out R multiples and what each mistake costs
